# Alliant University

> Alliant University is an accredited online and private university offering graduate and doctoral programs in psychology, business, data analytics, counseling, and organizational leadership across multiple California locations.

Alliant University serves students through its California School of Professional Psychology (CSPP) and School of Management and Leadership, with APA-accredited clinical psychology programs and STEM-designated graduate degrees. The institution operates multiple campuses across California including San Diego, Los Angeles, Sacramento, Fresno, and San Francisco, with robust online learning options.

## Doctoral Programs

- [PhD in Clinical Psychology](https://www.alliant.edu/clinical-psychology/phd): APA-accredited PhD in Clinical Psychology from CSPP for mental health training and clinical practice.
- [PsyD in Clinical Psychology](https://www.alliant.edu/clinical-psychology/psyd): APA-accredited PsyD in Clinical Psychology with five California campus locations available.
- [PhD in Organizational Leadership](https://www.alliant.edu/organizational-leadership/phd-leadership): PhD in Organizational Leadership for career and personal development with AI training and consulting.
- [PhD in Industrial & Organizational Psychology](https://www.alliant.edu/organizational-psychology/phd-io-psychology): PhD in Industrial & Organizational Psychology with data analytics and organizational development focus.
- [PhD in Marriage and Family Therapy](https://www.alliant.edu/marital-and-family-therapy/phd-mft): Doctorate in Marital & Family Therapy with research-intensive clinical training and licensure preparation.
- [Doctor of Business Administration (DBA)](https://www.alliant.edu/business-administration/dba): Accredited Doctor of Business Administration doctoral program with dissertation and executive education.
- [PsyD in Marital and Family Therapy](https://www.alliant.edu/marital-and-family-therapy/psyd-mft): COAMFTE-accredited PsyD in Marital and Family Therapy for couples and family therapy clinical practice.

## Master's Programs - Business & Technology

- [Master of Business Administration (MBA)](https://www.alliant.edu/business-administration/mba): MBA program with concentrations in Information Technology Management and Marketing & Digital Trends.
- [MS in Data Analytics Online & in California](https://www.alliant.edu/data-analytics/ms-data-analytics): STEM-accredited MS in Data Analytics with healthcare analytics emphasis, offered online and on-campus.
- [MS in Healthcare Analytics](https://www.alliant.edu/healthcare-analytics/ms-healthcare-analytics): STEM-accredited Master's in Healthcare Analytics (MSHA) with advanced healthcare analysis emphasis.
- [MS Information Systems Technology (MSIST)](https://www.alliant.edu/information-systems-technology/ms-information-systems-technology): STEM Master's in Information Systems Technology with machine learning and cybersecurity specialization.

## Master's Programs - Psychology & Counseling

- [MA in Clinical Counseling](https://www.alliant.edu/clinical-counseling/macc): CACREP-accredited online MA in Clinical Counseling with licensure preparation and internship training.
- [MA in Marriage and Family Therapy (MFT)](https://www.alliant.edu/marital-and-family-therapy/ma): COAMFTE-accredited online MA in Marriage and Family Therapy with clinical licensure preparation.
- [MA in Organizational Psychology](https://www.alliant.edu/organizational-psychology/maop): One-year MA in Organizational Psychology focusing on human resources and talent management.
- [MS in Clinical Psychopharmacology](https://www.alliant.edu/clinical-psychopharmacology/ms-clinical-psychopharmacology): Postdoctoral MS in Clinical Psychopharmacology from CSPP for prescriptive authority in psychotropic medications.
- [Online Accredited Master's in Social Work (MSW)](https://www.alliant.edu/social-work/msw): CSWE-accredited online MSW program for clinical social work and licensure preparation.

## Specialized Programs & Respecialization

- [Respecialization in Clinical Psychology](https://www.alliant.edu/psychology-certificates/doctoral-respecialization): Doctoral respecialization program for doctorate holders pursuing clinical psychology licensure.

## Student & Faculty Resources

- [Alliant University Homepage](https://www.alliant.edu): Alliant University homepage with accredited graduate & undergraduate programs in Psychology, Education, Business, Forensics, & Law.
- [Student Portal](https://portal.alliant.edu): Student, faculty, and applicant portal for self-service access to academic information and course schedules.
- [Faculty Explorer](https://www.alliant.edu/faculty): Faculty directory and explorer tool for searching faculty profiles across Alliant schools and programs.
